(() => { const hud=document.getElementById('hud').getBoundingClientRect(),field=document.getElementById('fieldCallouts').getBoundingClientRect(),combo=document.getElementById('comboDisplay');if(field.top<hud.bottom-1)throw Error('Callout layer intrudes into HUD');const overlap=(a,b)=>a.left<b.right&&a.right>b.left&&a.top<b.bottom&&a.bottom>b.top;if(combo.classList.contains('visible')){const r=combo.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.top<hud.bottom-1||r.left<field.left-1||r.right>field.right+1||r.bottom>field.bottom+1)throw Error('Combo is outside the field');for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('#hud .resource,#hud button'))if(overlap(r,el.getBoundingClientRect()))throw Error('Combo covers HUD data or a button');}for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('#damageNumbers .dmg-num')){const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.top<hud.bottom-1||r.left<field.left-1||r.right>field.right+1||r.bottom>field.bottom+1)throw Error('Damage float is outside its safe field');}for(const box of nexusBuffLayout.positions.values()){if(box.x<8||box.y<68||box.x+box.width>viewW-8||box.y+box.height>viewH-8)throw Error('Buff caption clipped');for(const tower of towers)if(Math.hypot(tower.x-Math.max(box.x,Math.min(tower.x,box.x+box.width)),tower.y-Math.max(box.y,Math.min(tower.y,box.y+box.height)))<51.9)throw Error('Buff caption covers a tower');} })()
